text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer! I hope you have a good one.
At the start of the new year, Fuji Kiseki stops by to give her holiday greetings.
choice_data_list: Happy New Year to you too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now, then…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you'll be doing a lot for me this year, so I prepared a heartfelt gift to thank you in advance.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Do you have any idea what it might be?
choice_data_list: I can't even begin to guess.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My gift to you is some heart-pounding excitement!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Let the New Year's talent show begin!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Sorry for springing this on you, but it's a special day, and I want you to enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I've already readied a line-up of performances, so just choose what you'd like to see!
Fuji Kiseki presents me with a list of three different options.
choice_data_list: A show of dexterous umbrella juggling.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The monologue, is it? Gotcha! I used to recite this one all the time as a kid!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Inhale… Exhale…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "To be, or not to be, that is the question: whether 'tis nobler in the mind to suffer…"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "To die, to sleep no more; and by a sleep, to say we end the heartache…"
Though she's reciting a well-known monologue, she packs it with a level of nuance that makes it feel fresh.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "To sleep, perchance to dream; aye, there's the rub, for in that sleep of death, what dreams may come…"
Her performance is so impressive, I start clapping and cheering the moment she finishes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Seeing you this delighted makes me want to thank my younger self for all her tireless practice!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Roger! Things are about to get flashy!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hit it!
At her prompt, "Make Debut!" starts playing from somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hup! Hah!
She begins to do cartwheels and somersaults and puts on a dazzling acrobatic show!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff! How was that?
Fuji Kiseki's new choreography totally transformed the mood of the song.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! I'm glad you enjoyed it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should get some of my dorm residents to join me and choreograph a version for eighteen people next time!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Okay! Umbrella juggling it is.
The umbrella juggling show Fuji Kiseki puts on for me is exquisite beyond words!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, ah, ah! Phew! That was close!
The umbrellas tip precariously on her palms, but she never lets them fall. They're as light as sunbeams in her hands.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hah!
For the last act, she propels a ball high, high, high into the air from the parasol's rim and catches it neatly with a grin!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank you for your patronage.
Thanks to Fuji Kiseki, I have a wonderfully fun New Year's Day.
I'm sure this year will be one filled with victories. I'm ready to work hard with her and take her to the top!
